# Grist

---

## A spreadsheet or a database

::: {.incremental}
- Grist is an Open Source spreadsheet engine, that we can run:
    - locally
    - in the cloud or homelab
    - as a SaaS (like Google Docs) [https://getgrist.com](https://getgirst.com)
- It stores everything as a SQLite database that is easy to share and backup.
- The visualization of the data can be customized, also know as Custom Widgets.

:::

::: {.notes}

Talk about the SMVE (check if time allows)

:::

## How we're going to try out Grist

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {
  "theme": "base",
  "flowchart": {"curve": "linear", "htmlLabels": true, "nodeSpacing": 34, "rankSpacing": 42, "diagramPadding": 4},

    subgraph ServiceRow["Services and ports"]
        direction LR
        Caddy["Caddy<br/><b>localhost:8000 → :80</b>"]
        Marimo["Marimo<br/><b>localhost:8081 → :8080</b>"]
        Grist["Grist<br/><b>localhost:8484 → :8484</b>"]
        WebUI["Hermes WebUI<br/><b>localhost:4096 → :8787</b>"]
        Hermes["Hermes<br/><b>:8642 internal</b>"]
        Caddy ~~~ Marimo ~~~ Grist ~~~ WebUI
        WebUI -->|"HTTP API"| Hermes
    end

    subgraph MountRow["Volumes and bind mounts · labels show consumers"]
        direction LR
        CaddyFiles["<b>Caddy files · RO</b><br/>Caddy → /srv · Caddyfile"]
        Workspace["<b>Workspace bind</b><br/>Marimo + WebUI → /workspace"]
        GristData[("<b>grist-data</b><br/>Grist → /persist")]
        HermesData[("<b>hermes-data</b><br/>Hermes → /opt/data<br/>WebUI → ~/.hermes")]
        HermesSource[("<b>hermes-agent-src</b><br/>Hermes → /opt/hermes<br/>WebUI → agent · RO")]
        CaddyFiles ~~~ Workspace ~~~ GristData ~~~ HermesData ~~~ HermesSource
    end

    ServiceRow ~~~ MountRow

    classDef service fill:#d9eef7,stroke:#1f5d78,color:#17324d,stroke-width:2.5px;
```

## UI Structure

Working in Grist is organized in this way:

::: {.incremental}
- {{< fa globe >}} A site (each user has his/hers)
- {{< fa folder-open >}} A workspace, this is like folders and contain documents
- {{< fa file-lines >}} Documents
  - {{< fa database >}} Database
  - {{< fa table-columns >}} Pages, views and other presentation data

:::
